Contract ManageLoanTermCRUDService::modifyLoanTerm(itemid: Integer,content: String): Boolean {
	definition:
		term: LoanTerm = LoanTerm.allInstance()->any(o|o.ItemID = itemid),
		isUpdated: Boolean = if term.oclIsUndefined() 
		then false 
		else (term.Content = content) 
		endif 
	precondition:
		term.oclIsUndefined() = false
	postcondition:
		term.Content = content and
		result = true
}
